definitions: a light, open building or structure used for shelter, concerts, or exhibitions, typically in a park or garden.
a temporary building or tent, often elaborately decorated, used for entertainment or shelter at a fair or festival.
a building at a sports ground, especially for cricket, where players change and spectators may sit.
examples: The band played in the park pavilion.
They set up a large pavilion for the wedding reception.
The cricket pavilion offered a good view of the match.
